description: This file defines a console command class for clearing the cache in the Daux static site generator system. It sets up the command name and description, and implements the execution logic to clear cached data and output status messages.

classes.name: ClearCache
classes.description: A console command class to clear the cache for the Daux system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command name and description.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing process and outputs status messages.
